definitions.explanation: The industry and practice of processing raw fish and other marine products into preserved, prepared, or packaged food items. Includes smoking, drying, canning, and freezing of seafood.

examples.japanese: この{町|まち}は{水産|すいさん}{加工|かこう}で{栄|さか}えている。
examples.english: This town thrives on seafood processing.

examples.japanese: {水産|すいさん}{加工|かこう}{品|ひん}の{輸出|ゆしゅつ}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: Exports of processed seafood products are increasing.

examples.japanese: {北海道|ほっかいどう}は{水産|すいさん}{加工|かこう}{業|ぎょう}が{盛|さか}んで、{干物|ひもの}や{缶詰|かんづめ}を{全国|ぜんこく}に{出荷|しゅっか}している。
examples.english: Hokkaido has a thriving seafood processing industry, shipping dried fish and canned goods nationwide.

notes:
A compound of {水産|すいさん} (marine products, fishery) and {加工|かこう} (processing). Japan's extensive coastline and fishing tradition make seafood processing a significant industry, particularly in northern regions like Hokkaido and the Sanriku coast.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水産|すいさん}{加工|かこう}{品|ひん}: processed seafood products
- {水産|すいさん}{加工|かこう}{業|ぎょう}: seafood processing industry
- {水産|すいさん}{加工|かこう}{工場|こうじょう}: seafood processing plant
- {水産|すいさん}{加工|かこう}{会社|かいしゃ}: seafood processing company

PRODUCT EXAMPLES:
- {干物|ひもの}: dried fish
- {蒲鉾|かまぼこ}: fish cake
- {缶詰|かんづめ}: canned seafood
- {塩辛|しおから}: salted and fermented seafood
- {練|ね}り{製品|せいひん}: surimi products

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {水産業|すいさんぎょう}: fishery industry — the broader fishing and aquaculture sector
- {食品|しょくひん}{加工|かこう}: food processing — a broader category not limited to seafood
- {水産物|すいさんぶつ}: marine products — the raw materials before processing
